from pathlib import Path
import hashlib, json, os, shutil, signal, subprocess, tempfile, time
def digest(data: bytes) -> str:
    return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()

def pin(path: Path) -> dict:
    raw = path.read_bytes()
    return {"path": str(path), "sha256": digest(raw), "bytes": len(raw)}

def require(condition: bool, cause: str) -> None:
    if not condition:
        raise RuntimeError(cause)

def command(argv: list[str], timeout: int, env: dict, executable: Path) -> dict:
    before = pin(executable)
    started = time.monotonic()
    process = subprocess.Popen(argv, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE,
                               env=env, start_new_session=True)
    expired = False
    try:
        stdout, stderr = process.communicate(timeout=timeout)
    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
        expired = True
        os.killpg(process.pid, signal.SIGKILL)
        stdout, stderr = process.communicate()
    return {"argv": argv, "timeout_seconds": timeout, "timed_out": expired,
            "exit_code": process.returncode, "elapsed_seconds": time.monotonic() - started,
            "stdout": stdout.decode("utf-8", errors="replace"),
            "stderr": stderr.decode("utf-8", errors="replace"),
            "stdout_sha256": digest(stdout), "stderr_sha256": digest(stderr),
            "executable_before": before, "executable_after": pin(executable)}

base = Path("morsehgp3D_v8/audits").resolve()
result = dict(RECEIPT)
output = Path(OUTPUT).resolve()
require(output.is_relative_to(base) and not output.exists(),
        "alias.replay_output_create_only_in_audits")
require(digest(result["gate"].encode()) == result["gate_sha256"], "alias.gate_hash")
require(set(result["source_snapshots"]) == set(result["sources"]), "alias.source_set")
workspace = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix=".work_owner_alias_", dir=base))
result["status"] = "failed"
result["runs"] = []
source_paths = {}
try:
    for name, item in result["source_snapshots"].items():
        require(digest(item["text"].encode()) == item["sha256"], "alias.snapshot_hash")
        require(item["sha256"] == RECEIPT["sources"][name]["sha256"], "alias.capture_source_hash")
        dst = workspace / "src" / name
        dst.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        dst.write_text(item["text"])
        source_paths[name] = dst
    result["sources"] = {name: pin(path) for name, path in source_paths.items()}
    gate = workspace / "gate.cpp"
    gate.write_text(result["gate"])
    require(pin(gate)["sha256"] == result["gate_sha256"], "alias.materialized_gate_hash")
    compiler = Path(shutil.which("g++") or "missing-g++").resolve()
    for mode, flags in [("o2", ["-O2"]), ("san", ["-O1", "-g0",
                         "-fsanitize=address,undefined", "-fno-omit-frame-pointer", "-no-pie"])]:
        binary = workspace / ("alias_" + mode)
        env = dict(os.environ, TMPDIR=str(workspace))
        if mode == "san":
            env.update(ASAN_OPTIONS="detect_leaks=1:abort_on_error=1",
                       UBSAN_OPTIONS="halt_on_error=1:print_stacktrace=1")
        run = {"mode": mode}
        result["runs"].append(run)
        run["compile"] = command([str(compiler), "-std=c++20", "-Wall", "-Wextra",
            "-Wpedantic", "-Werror", *flags, "-I", str(workspace / "src"), str(gate),
            str(workspace / "src/pipeline/local_credits.cpp"), "-o", str(binary)], 30, env, compiler)
        require(run["compile"]["exit_code"] == 0 and not run["compile"]["timed_out"], "alias.compile")
        run["execute"] = command([str(binary)], 10, env, binary)
        require(run["execute"]["exit_code"] == 0 and not run["execute"]["timed_out"] and
                run["execute"]["stderr"] == "", "alias.execution")
        require(json.loads(run["execute"]["stdout"]) == {
            "status": "observed_input_buffer_alias", "same_buffer": True,
            "closed_special_members": 4, "lost_q2_pairs": 3}, "alias.observation")
        for operation in ("compile", "execute"):
            require(run[operation]["executable_before"] == run[operation]["executable_after"],
                    "alias.executable_changed")
    result["source_after"] = {name: pin(path) for name, path in source_paths.items()}
    require(result["sources"] == result["source_after"], "alias.copied_sources_changed")
    result["status"] = "observed_input_buffer_alias_o2_san"
    result["source_capture"] = "copied source hashes checked before and after this replay"
except Exception as error:
    result["error"] = str(error)
finally:
    shutil.rmtree(workspace)
    result["temporary_removed"] = not workspace.exists()
    with output.open("x") as stream:
        json.dump(result, stream, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
        stream.write("\n")
print(json.dumps({"status": result["status"], "receipt": str(output)}))
raise SystemExit(0 if result["status"] == "observed_input_buffer_alias_o2_san" else 1)
